clauses.pinyin: tuō míng huáng dì cí hǎi chuán shuō zhōng yuán gè zú de gòng tóng zǔ xiān
clauses.en: Attributed to the Yellow Emperor: 'Cihai' (Dictionary): The legendary common ancestor of all Central Plain tribes.

clauses.zh: 姬姓，号轩辕氏、有熊氏，少典之子。
clauses.pinyin: jī xìng hào xuān yuán shì yǒu xióng shì shǎo diǎn zhī zi
clauses.en: Surname Ji, titles Xuanyuan Shi, Youxiong Shi, son of Shaodian.

clauses.pinyin: nèi jīng diàn dìng le zàng xiàng
clauses.en: 'Neijing' established the foundation of Zang-Xiang,

clauses.pinyin: jīng luò lǐ lùn de jī chǔ
clauses.en: and meridian theory;

clauses.pinyin: duì jí bìng de fā shēng

clauses.pinyin: fā zhǎn

clauses.pinyin: bìng zhèng de zhěn duàn
clauses.en: diagnosis of disease patterns,

clauses.pinyin: zhì liáo děng jìn xíng le xì tǒng de chǎn shù
clauses.en: and treatment,

clauses.pinyin: tí chū zhì wèi bìng de guān diǎn
clauses.en: proposed the concept of 'treating unmanifested disease' (preventive medicine),

clauses.zh: 对临床实践具有重要的指导意义。
clauses.pinyin: duì lín chuáng shí jiàn jù yǒu zhòng yào de zhǐ dǎo yì yì
clauses.en: and has important guiding significance for clinical practice.

clauses.zh: （2）《难经》成书于汉之前，秦越人（扁鹊）所著。
clauses.pinyin: nàn jīng chéng shū yú hàn zhī qián qín yuè rén biǎn què suǒ zhù
clauses.en: (2) 'Nanjing' was written before the Han dynasty by Qin Yueren (Bian Que).

clauses.zh: 扁鹊中国历史上第一个进入正史的医家。
clauses.pinyin: biǎn què zhōng guó lì shǐ shàng dì yī gè jìn rù zhèng shǐ de yī jiā
clauses.en: Bian Que is the first physician in Chinese history to be recorded in official dynastic history.

clauses.zh: “难” ：质难以问答的方式探讨医学理论，
clauses.pinyin: nán zhì nàn yǐ wèn dá de fāng shì tàn tǎo yī xué lǐ lùn
clauses.en: 'Nan' (Difficult): Exploring medical theory through a question-and-answer format,

clauses.pinyin: gòng gè wèn dá bā shí yī jīng
clauses.en: totaling 81 questions and answers (also known as the 'Eighty-One Difficult Issues').

clauses.zh: 内容丰富，在脉诊和针灸治疗方面较《黄帝内经》更为详细。
clauses.pinyin: nèi róng fēng fù zài mài zhěn hé zhēn jiǔ zhì liáo fāng miàn jiào huáng dì nèi jīng gèng wéi xiáng xì
clauses.en: Rich in content, and more detailed than the 'Huangdi Neijing' regarding pulse diagnosis and acupuncture treatment.

clauses.zh: （3)《伤寒杂病论》·东汉末年 张仲景所著。
clauses.pinyin: shāng hán zá bìng lùn dōng hàn mò nián zhāng zhòng jǐng suǒ zhù
clauses.en: (3) 'Shanghan Zabing Lun': Written by Zhang Zhongjing at the end of the Eastern Han dynasty.

clauses.zh: 中医基础理论与临床紧密结合，确立了辨证论治原则。
clauses.pinyin: zhōng yī jī chǔ lǐ lùn yǔ lín chuáng jǐn mì jié hé què lì le biàn zhèng lùn zhì yuán zé
clauses.en: It tightly integrates basic TCM theory with clinical practice, establishing the principle of pattern differentiation and treatment.

clauses.zh: 晋代·王叔和等整理：《伤寒论》：外感疾病（六经辨证）张仲景《金匮要略》：内伤疾病（脏腑辨证）（约150～219年）
clauses.pinyin: jìn dài wáng shū hé děng zhěng lǐ shāng hán lùn wài gǎn jí bìng liù jīng biàn zhèng zhāng zhòng jǐng jīn guì yào lüè nèi shāng jí bìng zàng fǔ biàn zhèng yuē nián
clauses.en: Compiled by Wang Shuhe and others in the Jin dynasty: 'Shanghan Lun' (Treatise on Cold Damage): Exogenous diseases (Six Channels Differentiation); Zhang Zhongjing's 'Jinkui Yaolue' (Essential Prescriptions from the Golden Cabinet): Internal injury diseases (Zang-Fu organ differentiation). (Approx. 150-219 AD).

clauses.zh: 麻黄汤、小柴胡汤等经方沿用至今。
clauses.pinyin: má huáng tāng xiǎo chái hú tāng děng jīng fāng yán yòng zhì jīn
clauses.en: Classical formulas like Mahuang Tang (Ephedra Decoction) and Xiao Chaihu Tang (Minor Bupleurum Decoction) are still in use today.

clauses.zh: 唐代传入日本、朝鲜，称汉方医学。
clauses.pinyin: táng dài chuán rù rì běn cháo xiǎn chēng hàn fāng yī xué
clauses.en: Introduced to Japan and Korea during the Tang dynasty, it is called Kampo medicine.

clauses.zh: 150 首方被日本药界制成颗粒，医疗保险可以报销。
clauses.pinyin: shǒu fāng bèi rì běn yào jiè zhì chéng kē lì yī liáo bǎo xiǎn kě yǐ bào xiāo
clauses.en: 150 formulas are processed into granules by the Japanese pharmaceutical industry and are covered by medical insurance.

clauses.zh: 称之为“医方之祖”，张仲景 医圣祠药精效宏。
clauses.pinyin: chēng zhī wéi yī fāng zhī zǔ zhāng zhòng jǐng yī shèng cí yào jīng xiào hóng
clauses.en: Known as the 'Ancestor of Medical Formulas', Zhang Zhongjing's Temple of the Medical Sage is revered for its potent and effective medicine.

clauses.zh: （4） 《神农本草经》中国现存最早的药物学专著，
clauses.pinyin: shén nóng běn cǎo jīng zhōng guó xiàn cún zuì zǎo de yào wù xué zhuān zhù
clauses.en: (4) 'Shennong Bencao Jing': The earliest extant book on pharmacology in China,

clauses.pinyin: zài yào zhǒng
clauses.en: recording 365 types of medicinal substances.

clauses.pinyin: fēn lèi shàng zhōng xià sān pǐn fēn lèi
clauses.en: Classification: Classified into Superior, Medium, and Inferior grades.

clauses.zh: 药性理论：君、臣、佐、使，四气五味，七情合和。
clauses.pinyin: yào xìng lǐ lùn jūn chén zuǒ shǐ sì qì wǔ wèi qī qíng hé hé
clauses.en: Theory of medicinal properties: Sovereign, Minister, Assistant, and Envoy, Four Natures and Five Flavors, and Seven Emotions of herb combinations.

clauses.zh: 价值：奠定了中药学理论基础。
clauses.pinyin: jià zhí diàn dìng le zhōng yào xué lǐ lùn jī chǔ
clauses.en: Value: Established the theoretical foundation of Chinese Materia Medica.

clauses.zh: （二）中医学理论体系的发展汉代以后，
clauses.pinyin: èr zhōng yī xué lǐ lùn tǐ xì de fā zhǎn hàn dài yǐ hòu
clauses.en: (II) Development of the TCM Theoretical System: After the Han Dynasty,

clauses.pinyin: yī xué lǐ lùn bù duàn chuàng xīn
clauses.en: medical theories were continuously innovated,

clauses.pinyin: zhì liáo jì shù bù duàn tí gāo
clauses.en: therapeutic techniques were constantly improved,

clauses.zh: 中医学进入了全面发展时期。
clauses.pinyin: zhōng yī xué jìn rù le quán miàn fā zhǎn shí qī
clauses.en: and Traditional Chinese Medicine entered a period of comprehensive development.

clauses.pinyin: wèi jìn suí táng shí qī
clauses.en: 1. The Wei, Jin, Sui, and Tang Dynasties

clauses.zh: 晋·王叔和《脉经》，第一部脉学专著。
clauses.pinyin: jìn wáng shū hé mài jīng dì yī bù mài xué zhuān zhù
clauses.en: Wang Shuhe (Jin Dynasty) wrote the 'Pulse Classic' (Mai Jing), the first monograph on sphygmology (the study of pulse diagnosis).

clauses.zh: 晋·皇甫谧《针灸甲乙经》，最早的针灸学专著。
clauses.pinyin: jìn huáng fǔ mì zhēn jiǔ jiǎ yǐ jīng zuì zǎo de zhēn jiǔ xué zhuān zhù
clauses.en: Huangfu Mi (Jin Dynasty) wrote the 'A-B Classic of Acupuncture and Moxibustion' (Zhenjiu Jiayi Jing), the earliest monograph on acupuncture and moxibustion.

clauses.zh: 晋·葛洪《肘后备急方》为中医学第一部临床急症著作。
clauses.pinyin: jìn gě hóng zhǒu hòu bèi jí fāng wèi zhōng yī xué dì yī bù lín chuáng jí zhèng zhù zuò
clauses.en: Ge Hong (Jin Dynasty) wrote 'Emergency Prescriptions Kept Up One's Sleeve' (Zhouhou Beiji Fang), the first TCM work on clinical emergency medicine.

clauses.zh: 隋·巢元方《诸病源候论》，第一部病因病机证候学专著。
clauses.pinyin: suí cháo yuán fāng zhū bìng yuán hòu lùn dì yī bù bìng yīn bìng jī zhèng hòu xué zhuān zhù
clauses.en: Chao Yuanfang (Sui Dynasty) wrote 'General Treatise on the Causes and Manifestations of Disease' (Zhu Bing Yuan Hou Lun), the first monograph on the study of disease etiology, pathogenesis, and patterns (syndromes).

clauses.zh: 唐·孙思邈《备急千金要方》和《千金翼方》第一部医学百科全书，
clauses.pinyin: táng sūn sī miǎo bèi jí qiān jīn yào fāng hé qiān jīn yì fāng dì yī bù yī xué bǎi kē quán shū
clauses.en: Sun Simiao (Tang Dynasty) wrote the 'Essential Formulas for Emergencies Worth a Thousand Gold' (Beiji Qianjin Yaofang) and the 'Supplement to the Essential Formulas Worth a Thousand Gold' (Qianjin Yifang), the first medical encyclopedias,

clauses.zh: 代表了盛唐医学发展水平。
clauses.pinyin: dài biǎo le shèng táng yī xué fā zhǎn shuǐ píng
clauses.en: which represent the level of medical development during the peak of the Tang Dynasty.

clauses.zh: 提出了“大医精诚”，开中国医学伦理学之先河。
clauses.pinyin: tí chū le dà yī jīng chéng kāi zhōng guó yī xué lún lǐ xué zhī xiān hé
clauses.en: He proposed 'The Sincerity of the Great Physician,' pioneering the field of Chinese medical ethics.

clauses.pinyin: sòng jīn yuán shí qī gōng yuán nián
clauses.en: 2. The Song, Jin, and Yuan Dynasties (960–1368 AD)

clauses.zh: 北宋·钱已（字仲阳）著成《小儿药证直诀》，
clauses.pinyin: běi sòng qián yǐ zì zhòng yáng zhù chéng xiǎo ér yào zhèng zhí jué
clauses.en: Qian Yi (courtesy name Zhongyang) of the Northern Song Dynasty authored 'Key to Therapeutics of Children's Diseases' (Xiao'er Yaozheng Zhijue),

clauses.pinyin: xì tǒng lùn shù le xiǎo ér tǐ zhì
clauses.en: systematically discussing pediatric constitution,

clauses.pinyin: bìng jī jí zhì liáo tè diǎn
clauses.en: pathogenesis, and treatment characteristics.

clauses.zh: 南宋·陈言（字无择）著成《三因极一病证方论》，
clauses.pinyin: nán sòng chén yán zì wú zé zhù chéng sān yīn jí yī bìng zhèng fāng lùn
clauses.en: Chen Yan (courtesy name Wuze) of the Southern Song Dynasty authored 'Treatise on Three Categories of Pathogenic Factors and Formulas' (Sanyin Jiyi Bingzheng Fanglun),

clauses.pinyin: jiǎn chēng sān yīn fāng sān yīn xué shuō
clauses.en: abbreviated as 'Sanyin Fang,' which introduced the Three-Cause Theory.

clauses.zh: 金元四大家刘完素（字守真），
clauses.pinyin: jīn yuán sì dà jiā liú wán sù zì shǒu zhēn
clauses.en: One of the Four Great Masters of the Jin and Yuan Dynasties, Liu Wansu (courtesy name Shouzhen),

clauses.zh: 创河间学派（后人尊称刘河间），
clauses.pinyin: chuàng hé jiān xué pài hòu rén zūn chēng liú hé jiān
clauses.en: founded the Hejian School (later generations respectfully called him Liu Hejian),

clauses.pinyin: chàng dǎo huǒ rè lùn hán liáng pài
clauses.en: advocating the 'Fire-Heat Theory'—the Cold-Cool School.

clauses.pinyin: zhāng cóng zhèng zì zi hé
clauses.en: Zhang Congzheng (courtesy name Zihe,

clauses.pinyin: hào dài rén
clauses.en: alias Dairen),

clauses.pinyin: chàng xié fēi rén shēn suǒ yǒu
clauses.en: advocated that 'pathogens are not native to the human body;'

clauses.pinyin: xié qù zé zhèng ān gōng xié pài
clauses.en: once pathogens are removed, the righteous (healthy) qi is restored—the Purgative (Attack) School.

clauses.pinyin: lǐ gǎo zì míng zhī
clauses.en: Li Gao (courtesy name Mingzhi,

clauses.pinyin: hào dōng yuán lǎo rén
clauses.en: alias Elder Dongyuan),

clauses.zh: 倡“百病皆由脾胃衰而生也”—补土派。
clauses.pinyin: chàng bǎi bìng jiē yóu pí wèi shuāi ér shēng yě bǔ tǔ pài
clauses.en: advocated that 'all diseases arise from the weakening of the Spleen and Stomach'—the Earth-Supplementing School.

clauses.pinyin: zhū zhèn hēng zì yàn xiū
clauses.en: Zhu Zhenheng (courtesy name Yanxiu,

clauses.pinyin: hào dān xī wēng
clauses.en: alias Danxi Weng,

clauses.pinyin: hòu rén zūn chēng zhū dān xī
clauses.en: later generations respectfully called him Zhu Danxi),

clauses.pinyin: chàng yáng cháng yǒu yú
clauses.en: advocated that 'Yang is often in excess,'

clauses.pinyin: yīn cháng bù zú zī yīn pài
clauses.en: and 'Yin is often deficient'—the Yin-Nourishing School.

clauses.pinyin: liú wán sù gōng yuán nián zì shǒu zhēn
clauses.en: Liu Wansu (1120–1200 AD), courtesy name Shouzhen,

clauses.pinyin: hé běi hé jiān rén
clauses.en: was from Hejian, Hebei,

clauses.pinyin: gù yì chēng liú hé jiān
clauses.en: hence he is also known as Liu Hejian,

clauses.pinyin: bié hào shǒu zhēn zi
clauses.en: with the alternative alias Shouzhenzi,

clauses.pinyin: zì hào
clauses.en: and he styled himself,

clauses.pinyin: tōng xuán chǔ shì
clauses.en: the Recluse of Profound Truth.

clauses.zh: 是宋金医学界最早敢于创新并且影响较大的一位医家，
clauses.pinyin: shì sòng jīn yī xué jiè zuì zǎo gǎn yú chuàng xīn bìng qiě yǐng xiǎng jiào dà de yī wèi yī jiā
clauses.en: He was the earliest physician in the Song and Jin medical community to dare to innovate and was highly influential.

clauses.pinyin: liú shì rèn wéi fǎ zhī yǔ shù
clauses.en: Liu believed that 'all methods and techniques',

clauses.pinyin: xī chū nèi jīng zhī xuán jī
clauses.en: derive entirely from the profound mechanisms of the 'Inner Canon' (Huangdi Neijing).

clauses.zh: 创造性地发挥了《内经》病机十九条的理论，
clauses.pinyin: chuàng zào xìng dì fā huī le nèi jīng bìng jī shí jiǔ tiáo de lǐ lùn
clauses.en: He creatively expanded upon the 'Nineteen Pathogenic Mechanisms' theory from the 'Inner Canon',

clauses.zh: 认为疾病多因火热而起，
clauses.pinyin: rèn wéi jí bìng duō yīn huǒ rè ér qǐ
clauses.en: believing that most diseases arise due to fire and heat.

clauses.pinyin: chàng liù qì jiē cóng huǒ huà shuō
clauses.en: He advocated the theory that 'the six qi all transform into fire,'

clauses.pinyin: zhì liáo duō yòng hán liáng yào
clauses.en: and in treatment, he often used cold and cool herbs,

clauses.pinyin: shì chēng hán liáng pài
clauses.en: becoming known in the world as the 'Cold-Cool School.'

clauses.pinyin: lǐ gǎo gōng yuán nián
zì míng zhī
clauses.en: courtesy name Mingzhi,

clauses.pinyin: hào dōng yuán lǎo rén
clauses.en: alias Elder Dongyuan,

clauses.zh: 是著名医家张元素的高徒，
clauses.pinyin: shì zhù míng yī jiā zhāng yuán sù de gāo tú
clauses.en: was a top student of the famous physician Zhang Yuansu.

clauses.zh: 他发探了张氏脏腑辨证之长，
clauses.pinyin: tā fā tàn le zhāng shì zàng fǔ biàn zhèng zhī zhǎng
clauses.en: He explored the strengths of Zhang's Zang-Fu organ differentiation,

clauses.pinyin: qū fēn le wài gǎn yǔ nèi shāng
clauses.en: distinguishing between external contraction (exterior patterns) and internal damage (internal conditions).

clauses.zh: 认为“人以胃气为本”，“内伤脾胃，百病由生”。
clauses.pinyin: rèn wéi rén yǐ wèi qì wèi běn nèi shāng pí wèi bǎi bìng yóu shēng
clauses.en: He believed that 'humans are rooted in Stomach qi,' and 'when the Spleen and Stomach are damaged, the hundred diseases are born.'

clauses.zh: 首创内伤学说理论，代表作是《脾胃论》。
clauses.pinyin: shǒu chuàng nèi shāng xué shuō lǐ lùn dài biǎo zuò shì pí wèi lùn
clauses.en: He pioneered the theory of Internal Damage, and his representative work is the 'Treatise on the Spleen and Stomach' (Piwei Lun).

clauses.zh: 他采取了一套以“调理脾胃”，
clauses.pinyin: tā cǎi qǔ le yī tào yǐ tiáo lǐ pí wèi
clauses.en: He adopted a set of therapeutic methods primarily focused on 'regulating the Spleen and Stomach'

clauses.pinyin: shēng jǔ qīng yáng wéi zhǔ de zhì liáo fāng fǎ
clauses.en: and 'raising the clear Yang qi,'

clauses.pinyin: shì chēng bǔ tǔ pài
clauses.en: becoming known in the world as the 'Earth-Supplementing School.'

clauses.pinyin: suǒ chuàng de bù shǎo zhù míng fāng jì
clauses.en: Many famous formulas he created,

clauses.pinyin: rú shēng yáng yì wèi tāng
clauses.en: such as Raising Yang and Benefiting the Stomach Decoction,

clauses.pinyin: bǔ zhōng yì qì tāng wán
clauses.en: Decoction (or Pills) to Supplement the Center and Benefit Qi,

clauses.zh: 调中益气汤等等为后世广泛应用。
clauses.pinyin: diào zhōng yì qì tāng děng děng wèi hòu shì guǎng fàn yìng yòng
clauses.en: and Regulating the Center and Benefiting Qi Decoction, etc., are widely used by later generations.

clauses.zh: 其著作多由其徒罗谦甫整理。
clauses.pinyin: qí zhù zuò duō yóu qí tú luó qiān fǔ zhěng lǐ
clauses.en: His works were mostly compiled by his student Luo Qianfu.

clauses.zh: 张从正（约公元1156-1228年），字子和，号戴人。
clauses.pinyin: zhāng cóng zhèng yuē gōng yuán nián zì zi hé hào dài rén
clauses.en: Zhang Congzheng (approx. 1156–1228 AD), courtesy name Zihe, alias Dairen.

clauses.zh: 也是-位具有革新思想的医家，
clauses.pinyin: yě shì wèi jù yǒu gé xīn sī xiǎng de yī jiā
clauses.en: He was also a physician with innovative ideas.

clauses.zh: 其代表作是《儒门事亲》（其中前三卷为张氏亲撰），
clauses.pinyin: qí dài biǎo zuò shì rú mén shì qīn qí zhōng qián sān juǎn wèi zhāng shì qīn zhuàn
clauses.en: His representative work is 'Confucian's Duties to their Parents' (Rumen Shiqin) (the first three volumes of which were written by Zhang himself).

clauses.pinyin: zhāng shì sī shū liú hé jiān
clauses.en: Zhang was a private student of Liu Hejian,

clauses.pinyin: shàn yòng gōng fǎ
clauses.en: and was skilled at using 'attack methods' (purgative/expelling therapies).

clauses.pinyin: rèn wéi zhì bìng yīng zhuó zhòng qū xié
clauses.en: He believed that 'treating disease should focus on expelling pathogenic factors,'

clauses.pinyin: xié qù zé zhèng ān
clauses.en: and 'once pathogens are removed, the healthy qi is restored.'

clauses.pinyin: bù kě wèi gōng ér yǎng bìng
clauses.en: One should not fear using attacking methods and thereby 'nourish the disease.'

clauses.pinyin: fā zhǎn hé fēng fù le yìng yòng hàn
clauses.en: He developed and enriched the application of the three methods of 'sweating,'

clauses.pinyin: tǔ
clauses.en: 'vomiting,'

clauses.pinyin: xià sān fǎ
clauses.en: and 'purging' (downward drainage),

clauses.zh: 又有对医学理论和经验的综合整理，

clauses.zh: 使温病学说进一步得到完善。

clauses.en: further perfecting the Warm-Disease school.

clauses.zh: 王梦英著《温热经纬》《霍乱论》-“新感”“伏邪”
clauses.pinyin: wáng mèng yīng zhù wēn rè jīng wěi huò luàn lùn xīn gǎn fú xié
clauses.en: Wang Mengying authored 'Latitude and Longitude of Warm-Heat Diseases' (Wenre Jingwei) and 'Treatise on Cholera' (Huoluan Lun), covering 'newly contracted' and 'latent' pathogens.

clauses.en: a world-renowned masterpiece of Chinese Materia Medica.

clauses.zh: 全面总结了明以前的药性理论，保存了大量医药文献。
clauses.pinyin: quán miàn zǒng jié le míng yǐ qián de yào xìng lǐ lùn bǎo cún le dà liàng yī yào wén xiàn
clauses.en: It comprehensively summarized the theories of medicinal properties before the Ming dynasty and preserved a large amount of medical literature.

clauses.pinyin: zhōng guó rén zài shì jiè shàng dì yī cì tí chū lái zhí wù fēn lèi xué sī xiǎng

clauses.en: there was a major collision and fusion of Chinese and Western cultures,

clauses.en: and the development of TCM theory showed a trend where the old and new coexisted: one was the continued path of collecting and organizing previous academic achievements,

clauses.pinyin: rú nián dài cáo bǐng zhāng zhǔ biān de zhōng guó yī xué dà chéng
clauses.en: such as the 1930s 'Zhongguo Yixue Dacheng' (Great Encyclopedia of Chinese Medicine) edited by Cao Bingzhang,

clauses.zh: 是一部集古今中医学大成的巨著；
clauses.pinyin: shì yī bù jí gǔ jīn zhōng yī xué dà chéng de jù zhù
clauses.en: a masterpiece gathering ancient and modern TCM knowledge;

clauses.zh: 二是出现了中西汇通和中医学理论科学化的思潮，
clauses.pinyin: èr shì chū xiàn le zhōng xī huì tōng hé zhōng yī xué lǐ lùn kē xué huà de sī cháo
clauses.en: the second was the emergence of a movement to synthesize Chinese and Western medicine and make TCM theory scientific,

clauses.pinyin: yǐ táng zōng hǎi
clauses.en: with the School of Sin-Western Synthesis represented by Tang Zonghai,

clauses.pinyin: zhū pèi wén
clauses.en: Zhu Peiwen,

clauses.pinyin: yùn tiě qiáo
clauses.en: Yun Tieqiao,

clauses.zh: 张锡纯为代表的中西汇通学派，
clauses.pinyin: zhāng xī chún wèi dài biǎo de zhōng xī huì tōng xué pài
clauses.en: and Zhang Xichun,

clauses.pinyin: rèn wéi zhōng xī yī hù yǒu yōu liè
clauses.en: who believed that TCM and Western medicine each have their advantages and disadvantages,

clauses.pinyin: kě yǐ shū tú tóng guī
clauses.en: and can reach the same goal by different routes,

clauses.zh: 主张汲取西医之长以发展中医，
clauses.pinyin: zhǔ zhāng jí qǔ xī yī zhī zhǎng yǐ fā zhǎn zhōng yī
clauses.en: advocating for absorbing the strengths of Western medicine to develop TCM,

clauses.zh: 如张锡纯所著的《医学衷中参西录》。
clauses.pinyin: rú zhāng xī chún suǒ zhù de yī xué zhōng zhōng cān xī lù
clauses.en: such as Zhang Xichun's 'Yixue Zhongzhong Canxi Lu' (Records of Medicine that Bridges TCM and Western Medicine).

clauses.pinyin: xiàn dài shí qī xīn zhōng guó jiàn guó hòu

clauses.zh: 国家大力提倡中西医结合，
clauses.pinyin: guó jiā dà lì tí chàng zhōng xī yī jié hé
clauses.en: the state vigorously promoted the integration of Chinese and Western medicine,

clauses.zh: 继而倡导以现代多学科方法研究中医。
clauses.pinyin: jì ér chàng dǎo yǐ xiàn dài duō xué kē fāng fǎ yán jiū zhōng yī
clauses.en: and subsequently advocated studying TCM using modern multidisciplinary methods.

clauses.zh: 因而此时期中医学理论的发展主要呈现出三方面的趋势：一是中医学理论经过梳理研究而更加系统、
clauses.pinyin: yīn ér cǐ shí qī zhōng yī xué lǐ lùn de fā zhǎn zhǔ yào chéng xiàn chū sān fāng miàn de qū shì yī shì zhōng yī xué lǐ lùn jīng guò shū lǐ yán jiū ér gèng jiā xì tǒng
clauses.en: Therefore, the development of TCM theory in this period mainly shows three trends: First, TCM theory has become more systematic and standardized through organization and research,

clauses.pinyin: guī fàn
clauses.en: standardized,

clauses.zh: 如20世纪60年代编写的全国统编教材《内经讲义》，
clauses.pinyin: rú shì jì nián dài biān xiě de quán guó tǒng biān jiào cái nèi jīng jiǎng yì
clauses.en: such as the nationally compiled textbook 'Neijing Jiangyi' (Lectures on the Inner Canon) written in the 1960s,

clauses.zh: 发展为70年代的《中医学基础》，
clauses.pinyin: fā zhǎn wèi nián dài de zhōng yī xué jī chǔ
clauses.en: which developed into 'Zhongyixue Jichu' (Fundamentals of TCM) in the 1970s,

clauses.zh: 再分化为80年代《中医基础理论》，
clauses.pinyin: zài fēn huà wèi nián dài zhōng yī jī chǔ lǐ lùn
clauses.en: and then further divided into 'Zhongyi Jichu Lilun' (Basic Theory of TCM) in the 1980s,

clauses.en: which serves as its hallmark;

clauses.pinyin: èr shì yòng zhé xué
clauses.en: second, using philosophy,

clauses.en: cybernetics,

clauses.pinyin: xìn xī lùn
clauses.en: information theory,

clauses.pinyin: xì tǒng lùn
clauses.en: systems theory,

clauses.zh: 现代实证科学等多学科方法研究中医学，
clauses.pinyin: xiàn dài shí zhèng kē xué děng duō xué kē fāng fǎ yán jiū zhōng yī xué
clauses.en: and modern empirical science and other multidisciplinary methods to research TCM,

clauses.zh: 大量的专著和科研成果相继出现；
clauses.pinyin: dà liàng de zhuān zhù hé kē yán chéng guǒ xiāng jì chū xiàn
clauses.en: with numerous monographs and research results appearing one after another;

clauses.zh: 三是对中医学理论体系构建的思维方法进行研究，
clauses.pinyin: sān shì duì zhōng yī xué lǐ lùn tǐ xì gòu jiàn de sī wéi fāng fǎ jìn xíng yán jiū
clauses.en: third, conducting research on the thinking methods used to construct the TCM theoretical system,

clauses.zh: 探讨中医学理论概念的发生之源与继续发展、
clauses.pinyin: tàn tǎo zhōng yī xué lǐ lùn gài niàn de fā shēng zhī yuán yǔ jì xù fā zhǎn
clauses.en: exploring the origins of TCM theoretical concepts and their path toward continued development,

clauses.pinyin: chuàng xīn zhī lù
clauses.en: and innovation.

clauses.zh: 中医基础理论的发展与现代化，必须走继承与创新并行的发展之路。
clauses.pinyin: zhōng yī jī chǔ lǐ lùn de fā zhǎn yǔ xiàn dài huà bì xū zǒu jì chéng yǔ chuàng xīn bìng xíng de fā zhǎn zhī lù
clauses.en: The development and modernization of basic theory of TCM must follow a path of both inheritance and innovation.

clauses.zh: 继承是创新的基础，继承的目的是创新。

en_whole: 2) Diurnal Timing and Disease Prevention/Treatment: Based on the academic concept that human Qi and Blood fluctuate in accordance with the waxing and waning of Yin and Yang in the natural world, and circulate through the meridians (energy channels) at specific times, the ancients developed the 'Midnight-Noon Ebb-Flow Acupuncture' method (a system of timing acupuncture points according to the daily cycle). Selecting acupuncture points based on the day and time allows for more effective regulation of Qi and Blood, and the harmonization of Yin and Yang to prevent and treat disease. 3) Geographic Environment and Disease Prevention/Treatment: In health cultivation and disease prevention, it is necessary to adopt appropriate principles and methods based on different geographical environments, a concept known as 'adapting to local conditions' (Yin Di Zhi Yi). The geographical characteristics of China are such that the northwest terrain is high and the southeast is low; the northwest tends to be cold, dry, and cool, while the southeast tends to be warm, hot, and humid. Therefore, one should use fewer cold-natured medicinals in the northwest and be cautious about using pungent, hot-natured substances in the southeast.

en_whole: (3) Basic concept of 'Disease' (bing): 'Disease' is the abbreviated term for a morbid condition. It refers to a complete and abnormal life process characterized by specific pathogenic factors, patterns of onset, and a progression of pathogenesis (the mechanism of disease development). It typically involves relatively fixed clinical symptoms and signs, key points for diagnosis, and differentiations from similar conditions. When pathogenic influences (xie qi) act upon the human body, the body’s upright qi (zheng qi - the body's defensive/vital energy) struggles against them, leading to an imbalance of Yin and Yang, damage to the Zang-Fu organs and body structures, or dysfunction of physiological and psychological activities, thus manifesting as a complete abnormal life process. Throughout this process, there is a constant contradictory struggle between damage/obstruction and repair/regulation, known as the struggle between pathogenic factors and upright qi (xie-zheng douzheng). A disease reflects the overall attributes, characteristics, and regularities that persist throughout its entire course. Examples such as the common cold and chest impediment (xiong bi) are all concepts of a disease.

en_whole: Differentiating the disease location: This refers to the analysis and judgment used to determine where a disease is situated in the body. Different pathogenic factors (causes of disease) invade different parts of the body, leading to different disease patterns (syndromes). By identifying the location of the pathology, one can deduce the nature of the pathogenic factors (pathogens), understand the severity of the illness, and predict the potential progression or transformation of the disease; this is crucial for determining the correct pattern. Interior-exterior disease locations: Pathogens from external sources invading the skin and muscle layer (the superficial aspects of the body) are called 'exterior patterns'; internal injuries caused by emotional distress, improper diet, or overexertion or lack of activity, which directly damage the essence and qi of the Zang-Fu organs, are called 'interior patterns.' Zang-Fu organ disease locations: For example, coughing and phlegm are usually located in the Lungs, while abdominal bloating and loose stools are usually located in the Spleen and Stomach.

clauses.en: Using disease differentiation thinking to confirm a diagnosis,

clauses.pinyin: duì mǒu yī bìng de bìng yīn
clauses.en: provides an overall understanding of the cause,

clauses.zh: 病变规律和转归预后有一个总体的认识；
clauses.pinyin: bìng biàn guī lǜ hé zhuǎn guī yù hòu yǒu yí gè zǒng tǐ de rèn shi
clauses.en: pathological progression, and prognosis of a specific disease;

clauses.pinyin: zài yùn yòng biàn zhèng sī wéi
clauses.en: then, by applying pattern differentiation thinking,

clauses.zh: 根据该病当时的临床表现和检查结果来辨析其目前处于病变的哪一阶段或是哪一类型，
clauses.pinyin: gēn jù gāi bìng dāng shí de lín chuáng biǎo xiàn hé jiǎn chá jiē guǒ lái biàn xī qí mù qián chǔ yú bìng biàn de nǎ yī jiē duàn huò shì nǎ yī lèi xíng
clauses.en: and based on the current clinical manifestations and examination results, one analyzes the current stage or type of the pathology,

clauses.pinyin: cóng ér què lì qí dāng shí de zhèng
clauses.en: thereby establishing the 'pattern' at that moment,

clauses.zh: 然后根据“证”来确定治则治法和处方遣药。
clauses.pinyin: rán hòu gēn jù zhèng lái què dìng zhì zé zhì fǎ hé chǔ fāng qiǎn yào
clauses.en: and subsequently determining the treatment principle, method, and prescription.

clauses.zh: 对某些难以确诊的病症，可发挥辨证思维的优势，
clauses.pinyin: duì mǒu xiē nán yǐ què zhěn de bìng zhèng kě fā huī biàn zhèng sī wéi de yōu shì
clauses.en: For certain conditions that are difficult to diagnose, one can leverage the strengths of pattern differentiation thinking.

clauses.zh: 依据病人的临床表现，辨析出证，随证施治。
clauses.pinyin: yī jù bìng rén de lín chuáng biǎo xiàn biàn xī chū zhèng suí zhèng shī zhì
clauses.en: Based on the patient's clinical presentation, identify the pattern (Zheng) and treat accordingly.

clauses.zh: 根据具体情况，有时也使用“辨病施治”的方法，
clauses.pinyin: gēn jù jù tǐ qíng kuàng yǒu shí yě shǐ yòng biàn bìng shī zhì de fāng fǎ
clauses.en: Depending on the specific circumstances, the method of 'treating based on disease identification' (Bian Bing Shi Zhi) is sometimes also used,

clauses.zh: 如常山、青蒿治疟，黄连治痢等。
clauses.pinyin: rú cháng shān qīng hāo zhì nüè huáng lián zhì lì děng
clauses.en: such as using Changshan and Qinghao to treat malaria, or Coptis (Huang Lian) to treat dysentery.

clauses.pinyin: biàn zhèng yǔ biàn bìng xiāng jié hé
clauses.en: Combining pattern differentiation with disease identification.

clauses.zh: 辨病——确诊病——全过程和全貌总体的认识
clauses.pinyin: biàn bìng què zhěn bìng quán guò chéng hé quán mào zǒng tǐ de rèn shi
clauses.en: Disease identification (Bian Bing)—confirming the specific disease—an understanding of the entire process and overall picture.

clauses.zh: 辨证——确定证——阶段性或类型性本质的认识
clauses.pinyin: biàn zhèng què dìng zhèng jiē duàn xìng huò lèi xíng xìng běn zhì de rèn shi
clauses.en: Pattern differentiation (Bian Zheng)—determining the pattern—an understanding of the essence of the current stage or type.

clauses.zh: 辨病与辨证相结合——先辨病，
clauses.pinyin: biàn bìng yǔ biàn zhèng xiāng jié hé xiān biàn bìng
clauses.en: Combining disease identification and pattern differentiation—identify the disease first,

clauses.pinyin: zài biàn zhèng jì bǎ wò zǒng tǐ
clauses.en: then differentiating the pattern (grasping both the overall condition and clarifying the stage or type of the pathology),

clauses.zh: 亦辨析清病变的阶段或类型）
clauses.pinyin: yì biàn xī qīng bìng biàn de jiē duàn huò lèi xíng
clauses.en: and also clarify the stage or type of the pathological changes.

clauses.zh: 以辨病为先，以辨证为主
clauses.pinyin: yǐ biàn bìng wèi xiān yǐ biàn zhèng wéi zhǔ
clauses.en: Prioritize disease identification as the framework, and emphasize pattern differentiation as the guide for treatment.

clauses.pinyin: sān
clauses.en: III.

clauses.zh: 《中医基础理论》课程的主要内容中医基础理论，
clauses.pinyin: zhōng yī jī chǔ lǐ lùn kè chéng de zhǔ yào nèi róng zhōng yī jī chǔ lǐ lùn
clauses.en: Main content of the course 'Fundamentals of Traditional Chinese Medicine'. Fundamentals of TCM,

clauses.pinyin: shì zhōng yī xué de jī běn gài niàn
clauses.en: is a theoretical system of the basic concepts,

clauses.pinyin: jī běn zhī shi
clauses.en: basic knowledge,

clauses.zh: 基本原理和基本规律的理论体系。
clauses.pinyin: jī běn yuán lǐ hé jī běn guī lǜ de lǐ lùn tǐ xì
clauses.en: basic principles, and basic laws of TCM.

clauses.zh: 《中医基础理论》课程属于中医学及其相关学科的专业基础课和入门课。
clauses.pinyin: zhōng yī jī chǔ lǐ lùn kè chéng shǔ yú zhōng yī xué jí qí xiāng guān xué kē de zhuān yè jī chǔ kè hé rù mén kè
clauses.en: The 'Fundamentals of TCM' course is a foundational and introductory course for TCM and related disciplines.

clauses.zh: 《中医基础理论》课程的内容包括三个模块：即中医学的哲学基础、
clauses.pinyin: zhōng yī jī chǔ lǐ lùn kè chéng de nèi róng bāo kuò sān gè mó kuài jí zhōng yī xué de zhé xué jī chǔ
clauses.en: The content of the course includes three modules: the philosophical foundations of TCM,

clauses.zh: 中医学对人体生理活动的认识、
clauses.pinyin: zhōng yī xué duì rén tǐ shēng lǐ huó dòng de rèn shi
clauses.en: TCM's understanding of human physiological activities,

clauses.zh: 中医学对疾病基本规律及其防治原则的认识等。
clauses.pinyin: zhōng yī xué duì jí bìng jī běn guī lǜ jí qí fáng zhì yuán zé de rèn shi děng
clauses.en: and TCM's understanding of the basic laws of disease and their prevention and treatment principles.

clauses.zh: （一）中医学的哲学基础主要阐述中国古代哲学的气一元论、
clauses.pinyin: yī zhōng yī xué de zhé xué jī chǔ zhǔ yào chǎn shù zhōng guó gǔ dài zhé xué de qì yī yuán lùn
clauses.en: (I) The philosophical foundations of TCM mainly expound on ancient Chinese philosophy: Qi Monism,

clauses.pinyin: yīn yáng xué shuō
clauses.en: Yin-Yang theory,

clauses.zh: 五行学说及其在中医学中的应用。
clauses.pinyin: wǔ xíng xué shuō jí qí zài zhōng yī xué zhòng dì yìng yòng
clauses.en: the Five Elements (Wu Xing) theory, and their application in TCM.

clauses.zh: 气一元论，是探求宇宙本原和阐释宇宙变化的一种世界观和方法论。
clauses.pinyin: qì yī yuán lùn shì tàn qiú yǔ zhòu běn yuán hé chǎn shì yǔ zhòu biàn huà de yī zhǒng shì jiè guān hé fāng fǎ lùn
clauses.en: Qi Monism is a worldview and methodology for exploring the origin of the universe and explaining its changes.

clauses.zh: 阴阳学说，是对立统一的辩证法思想。
clauses.pinyin: yīn yáng xué shuō shì duì lì tǒng yī de biàn zhèng fǎ sī xiǎng
clauses.en: Yin-Yang theory is a dialectical philosophy of opposites and unity.

clauses.zh: 五行学说，是多元关系的系统论观点。
clauses.pinyin: wǔ xíng xué shuō shì duō yuán guān xi de xì tǒng lùn guān diǎn
clauses.en: The Five Elements theory is a systems-theory perspective on pluralistic relationships.

clauses.zh: （二）中医学对人体生理活动的认识主要阐释中医学有关人体生命活动的基本概念、
clauses.pinyin: èr zhōng yī xué duì rén tǐ shēng lǐ huó dòng de rèn shi zhǔ yào chǎn shì zhōng yī xué yǒu guān rén tǐ shēng mìng huó dòng de jī běn gài niàn
clauses.en: (II) TCM's understanding of human physiological activities mainly expounds on the basic concepts,

clauses.pinyin: jī běn lǐ lùn hé jī běn zhī shi
clauses.en: basic theories, and basic knowledge of human life activities in TCM,

clauses.pinyin: bāo kuò zàng xiàng
clauses.en: including Zang-Fu (Visceral Manifestation),

clauses.pinyin: jīng qì xuè jīn yè shén
clauses.en: Essence-Qi-Blood-Body Fluid-Shen (Spirit),

clauses.pinyin: jīng luò
clauses.en: Jing-Luo (Meridians and Collaterals),

clauses.pinyin: tǐ zhì děng
clauses.en: and Constitution.

clauses.zh: 藏象，研究人体脏腑结构、生理功能及其相互关系的理论。
clauses.pinyin: zàng xiàng yán jiū rén tǐ zàng fǔ jié gòu shēng lǐ gōng néng jí qí xiāng hù guān xì de lǐ lùn
clauses.en: Zang-Fu is the theory studying human organ structures, physiological functions, and their interrelationships.

clauses.zh: 精气血津液神，是研究人体生命物质及生命活动的理论。
clauses.pinyin: jīng qì xuè jīn yè shén shì yán jiū rén tǐ shēng mìng wù zhì jí shēng mìng huó dòng de lǐ lùn
clauses.en: Essence-Qi-Blood-Body Fluid-Shen is the theory studying the vital substances and activities of the human body.

clauses.pinyin: jīng luò
clauses.en: Jing-Luo,

clauses.zh: 是研究人体经络系统的循行分布、
clauses.pinyin: shì yán jiū rén tǐ jīng luò xì tǒng de xún xíng fēn bù
clauses.en: is the theory studying the course, distribution,

clauses.pinyin: shēng lǐ gōng néng
clauses.en: physiological functions,

clauses.zh: 病理变化及其与脏腑相互关系的理论。
clauses.pinyin: bìng lǐ biàn huà jí qí yǔ zàng fǔ xiāng hù guān xì de lǐ lùn
clauses.en: pathological changes of the meridian system, and their relationships with the Zang-Fu organs.

clauses.pinyin: tǐ zhì
clauses.en: Constitution,

clauses.zh: 是研究人体体质的形成、
clauses.pinyin: shì yán jiū rén tǐ tǐ zhì de xíng chéng
clauses.en: is the theory studying the formation,

clauses.pinyin: tè zhēng
clauses.en: characteristics,

clauses.zh: 类型及其与疾病的发生、
clauses.pinyin: lèi xíng jí qí yǔ jí bìng de fā shēng
clauses.en: types of human constitution, and their relationships with the occurrence,

clauses.pinyin: bìng yīn
clauses.en: etiology,

clauses.pinyin: bìng jī
clauses.en: pathogenesis,

clauses.pinyin: zhěn duàn
clauses.en: diagnosis,

clauses.zh: 预防和治疗关系的理论。
clauses.pinyin: yù fáng hé zhì liáo guān xi de lǐ lùn
clauses.en: prevention, and treatment of disease.

clauses.zh: （三）中医学对疾病基本规律及养生与防治原则的认识主要阐释中医学关于疾病的发生原因、
clauses.pinyin: sān zhōng yī xué duì jí bìng jī běn guī lǜ jí yǎng shēng yǔ fáng zhì yuán zé de rèn shi zhǔ yào chǎn shì zhōng yī xué guān yú jí bìng de fā shēng yuán yīn
clauses.en: (III) TCM's understanding of basic disease laws and health preservation and treatment principles mainly expounds on the TCM theories and methods regarding the causes of disease,

clauses.pinyin: fā bìng jī lǐ
clauses.en: pathogenesis,

clauses.pinyin: bìng biàn jī zhì
clauses.en: pathological mechanisms,

clauses.zh: 预防治疗的理论和方法，
clauses.pinyin: yù fáng zhì liáo de lǐ lùn hé fāng fǎ
clauses.en: prevention, and treatment,

clauses.pinyin: bāo kuò bìng yīn
clauses.en: including three parts: etiology,

clauses.zh: 病机和养生与防治原则等三部分。
clauses.pinyin: bìng jī hé yǎng shēng yǔ fáng zhì yuán zé děng sān bù fen
clauses.en: pathogenesis, and health preservation and treatment principles.

clauses.pinyin: bìng yīn
clauses.en: Etiology,

clauses.zh: 是研究病因分类和各种病因的性质、
clauses.pinyin: shì yán jiū bìng yīn fēn lèi hé gè zhǒng bìng yīn de xìng zhì
clauses.en: is the theory studying the classification of causes and the nature of various causes,

clauses.pinyin: zhì bìng tú jìng
clauses.en: pathways of disease occurrence,

clauses.zh: 致病特征以及探求病因方法的理论。
clauses.pinyin: zhì bìng tè zhēng yǐ jí tàn qiú bìng yīn fāng fǎ de lǐ lùn
clauses.en: characteristics of pathogenicity, and methods for investigating causes.

clauses.zh: 病机，是研究疾病发生、发展、变化机制的理论。
clauses.pinyin: bìng jī shì yán jiū jí bìng fā shēng fā zhǎn biàn huà jī zhì de lǐ lùn
clauses.en: Pathogenesis is the theory studying the mechanisms of disease occurrence, development, and change.

clauses.zh: 养生与防治原则，是关于保养生命、疾病预防和治疗原则的理论。
clauses.pinyin: yǎng shēng yǔ fáng zhì yuán zé shì guān yú bǎo yǎng shēng mìng jí bìng yù fáng hé zhì liáo yuán zé de lǐ lùn
clauses.en: Health preservation and treatment principles is the theory regarding the maintenance of life and the principles of disease prevention and treatment.
